findings.rule: Title block and notes must not contradict for critical process specifications.
findings.reasoning: The title block heat_treatment field is '---' (indicating none), but note N5 explicitly requires toughening to 24-32 HRC. A manufacturer following the title block will skip heat treatment, resulting in a part that fails its functional requirements.
findings.correction: Update the title block heat_treatment field to reference N5 or state 'TOUGHENED 24-32 HRC PER NOTE 5'.

findings.rule: Functional mating diameters on coupling components require explicit tolerances or fit classes.
findings.reasoning: Dimension D1 specifies the outer cylindrical surface (F1) of this coupling spacer as ⌀66 with no tolerance. Coupling spacers typically register or pilot into hubs; leaving this diameter to the general machining tolerance of ±0.8 mm (per IS 2102 for 30-120 mm range) is far too loose for a functional fit. Note N10 confirms ⌀66 is also the raw black bar size, meaning the finished OD has no specified removal or precision limit.
findings.correction: Add an appropriate tolerance or fit class (e.g., h7, h9, or a specific dimensional tolerance) to D1 based on the mating assembly requirements.

findings.rule: Finished envelope must be smaller than raw stock to allow material removal.
findings.reasoning: Note N10 specifies raw material as 'Ø66 BLACK ROUND BAR', while D1 specifies the finished outer diameter F1 as exactly ⌀66. Black round bar carries mill tolerances, scale, and decarburization; specifying the finished dimension equal to the nominal raw stock size leaves zero machining allowance to clean up the surface, making it impossible to guarantee the final dimension or surface finish.
findings.correction: Reduce the finished OD in D1 below 66 mm (e.g., ⌀65 or ⌀64) to provide adequate machining stock removal from the Ø66 black bar, or specify a larger raw material size in N10.
